name: New Password to Sign In
summary: The anonymous user submits a new password after recovery-code verification, the server replaces the password credential using the internally held reset authority, and the client returns to password sign-in.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.complete is visible with password-reset authority established by successful recovery-code verification

inputs.name: New Password
inputs.description: New password selected by the user.

serverInteraction.intent: Use the internally established password-reset authority to replace the password credential and complete recovery.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email.password is visible and the recovered account can authenticate with the new password

sourceReferences.note: ResetPasswordAsync applies the reset token to replace the password and records PasswordRecoveryCompleted on success.
This replaces the legacy reset-link completion scenario; the reset token is now derived only after six-digit code verification and remains internal to the application flow.
